en.t: Such a cruel lack of destined connection is truly hard to understand!

units.source_text: 王命妇亲见藤壶妃子为源氏公子而思慕愁叹之状，听了这诗，不能漠然无动于衷，便悄悄地答道：

en.t: Lady Omyobu had seen with her own eyes how Lady Fujitsubo longed for Prince Genji and sighed in sorrow; hearing this poem, she could not remain cold and unmoved, and quietly replied:
